title: Link customer sales-invoice evidence to sales-shipment evidence
description: Add explicit evidence rows that allocate recorded ERP-055 customer sales-invoice evidence to existing sales-shipment or container-shipment evidence using persisted identifiers only. Keep the invoice-to-order (ERP-055) and receipt-to-invoice (ERP-073) dimensions separate. Do not create another invoice or shipment master, infer links, issue a real invoice, post accounting, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation audits existing shipment and container evidence before adding the link model and does not replace or duplicate an existing authoritative shipment or invoice model.
Authorized users can link a recorded active customer sales-invoice evidence record to eligible non-cancelled shipment or container evidence using persisted identifiers only.

The server validates authoritative Customer and currency compatibility and rejects unavailable or cancelled shipment evidence, duplicate invoice and shipment pairs and non-positive linked quantities or amounts.

The invoice-to-order allocation (ERP-055) and receipt-to-invoice allocation (ERP-073) dimensions remain distinct and are never added to linked-shipment evidence as if they represented monetary settlement.
Linked and unlinked shipment evidence is separately visible; the absence of a link is shown as none or unknown and is never interpreted as shipped, delivered, invoiced, recognized or paid.
An incorrect link can be voided with a bounded reason while preserving original values, snapshots, recorder and timestamps; hard deletion and silent replacement are not provided.
Existing shipment lists and details surface bounded linked-invoice evidence without issuing a per-row database or storage query.
Creating, reading or voiding a link does not change invoices, Sales Orders, shipments, containers, receipts, Customers, inventory, tax, finance or settlement records.
Different currencies are never combined or converted unless an authoritative persisted conversion already belongs to the source evidence.
Schema changes are idempotent, lists are bounded or paged and legacy shipments remain readable without request-time or production backfill.

Unit and integration tests cover multiple invoices and shipments, Customer and currency mismatch, duplicate and cancelled-source rejection, void history, bounded summaries, model separation and source-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is recorded as deferred during development.

scenarios: Link one recorded customer sales-invoice evidence record to two compatible sales-shipment records and verify linked and unlinked shipment evidence without changing the invoice, shipment or any order record.
Attempt duplicate, cancelled-source, Customer-mismatched and currency-mismatched links, verify rejection, then void a valid link and confirm its original values and reason remain in history.

human_gate.reason: Explicit repository evidence linking and non-production validation only. Real invoicing, shipment execution, customs submission, accounting posting, production database mutation, deployment and release remain behind mandatory human gates.
